title: Summary: Working Together
objective: Count the commits a shared copy holds that you lack, pull them in, count again, and print a clean status.
prerequisites: Reading a Change as a Reviewer
hint: Set up the shared copy and the clone, and have the clone push Add teammate note. Back in the original: git fetch -q origin, then Write-Output Behind: with $(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main). Then git pull -q --ff-only origin main, the same count with Behind after pull:, and the if line that prints Status: clean.
